citation.authors: Yerram C, Jillella A, Reddy V
citation.journal: Journal of Ayurveda and Integrative Medicine

cited_by.title: Ashwagandha: cortisol, mood, skin, hair, heart, kidneys and liver

record.population: Healthy adults aged 18 to 45 with mild to moderate hair loss (61 analysed), India
record.design: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, topical ashwagandha root-extract serum for 75 days
record.finding: Hair shedding fell in the 60-second comb test and hair density, growth and thickness improved compared with placebo at day 75.
record.note: A serum on the scalp, not a capsule. Hair type not stated.
